lines.text: Last weekend, Josh finished his hike just before dark.
Today the clocks went back, and the sun set an hour earlier.
Same start time, same trail, and he walked the last mile in the dark.
Here's the fix. Check today's sunset, and set a turnaround time that gets you back an hour before it.
When that time comes, turn around, even if the top is close.
Save this before your next fall hike.
